title: 2015 AMC 12A Problem 3
statement: Mr. Patrick teaches math to \(15\) students. He was grading tests and found that when he graded everyone’s test except Payton’s, the average grade for the class was \(80.\) After he graded Payton’s test, the class average became \(81.\) What was Payton’s score on the test?

solutions.text:
The sum of the \(14\) other scores was \(14\cdot 80 = 1120.\) The sum of all \(15\) scores was \(15\cdot 81 = 1215.\)

Therefore Payton’s score was \(1215 - 1120 = 95.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E.
